description_en: Queries the list of ECS instances in the warm pool of a scaling group
description_zh: 查询伸缩组预热池内的ECS实例列表
name: DescribeWarmPoolInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. An empty NextToken indicates that no more results are available
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的 NextToken 参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数，取值范围：1~50。 默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. An empty NextToken indicates that no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

WarmPoolInstances.description_en: The list of ECS instances in the warm pool

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the ECS instance was added to the warm pool, accurate to seconds. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreatedTime.description_zh: ECS 实例加入预热池的时间，精确到秒，采用 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

LaunchTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the instance launch template

LaunchTemplateVersion.description_en: The version of the instance launch template

LifecycleState.description_en:
The lifecycle state of the ECS instance in the warm pool. Valid values:

Pending: Joining. The ECS instance is being added to the warm pool.

Pending:Wait: Joining suspended. If a lifecycle hook applicable to warm pool scale-out activities is created in the scaling group, the ECS instance is suspended when added to the warm pool and waits for the hook timeout period to end.

Removing: Removing. The ECS instance is being removed from the warm pool during a scale-in.

Removing:Wait: Removing suspended. If a lifecycle hook applicable to warm pool scale-in activities is created in the scaling group, the ECS instance is suspended when removed from the warm pool and waits for the hook timeout period to end.

Running: Running. The ECS instance is successfully added to the warm pool and is in the running state.

Stopped: Economical mode. The ECS instance is successfully added to the warm pool and is in the stopped state
LifecycleState.description_zh:
ECS 实例在预热池中的生命周期状态，可能值：

Pending：加入中。ECS实例正在加入预热池中。

Pending:Wait：加入挂起中。如果伸缩组内创建了适用于预热池扩张活动的生命周期挂钩，ECS实例在加入预热池时被挂起并等待挂钩超时时间结束。

Removing：移出中。ECS实例正在从预热池缩容移除中。

Removing:Wait：移出挂起中。如果伸缩组内创建了适用于预热池收缩活动的生命周期挂钩，ECS 实例在移出预热池时被挂起并等待挂钩超时时间结束。

Running：运行中，ECS实例成功加入预热池，并处于运行中状态。

Stopped：节省停机，ECS实例成功加入预热池，并处于节省停机状态

PrivateIpAddress.description_en: The private IP address of the instance

ScalingActivityId.description_en: The ID of the scaling activity when the ECS instance was added to the warm pool
ScalingActivityId.description_zh: ECS 实例加入预热池时，伸缩活动的 ID

ScalingConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the associated scaling configuration

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

ScalingInstanceId.description_en: The instance identity in the scaling group, which has a one-to-one correspondence with the ECS instance ID
ScalingInstanceId.description_zh: 伸缩组内的实例标识，与ECS实例的ID一一对应

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the ECS instance
